pages.text: The corpus divides the spirit-stone economy into low, middle, high, and supreme grades. Spirit stones already support cultivation absorption, market trade, voucher exchange, and some cross-region gates, forming the basis for sect contribution, Star Palace tax contracts, Tianyuan merit, and auctions.

pages.title: Four Grades of Spirit Stone
pages.text: Low-grade stones serve everyday Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment trade. Middle-grade stones circulate at Core Formation, high-grade stones support major transactions from Nascent Soul onward, and supreme-grade stones are reserved for auctions and elite settlements. The designed exchange ratio is 100:1 between adjacent grades.

pages.title: Current Currency Items
pages.text: Low-level markets primarily use the registered Five-Element low-grade spirit stones. Middle-, high-, and supreme-grade stone items are gradually entering higher-tier trade. Sect contribution, Tianyuan merit, and regional vouchers are documented by their respective shops or world-data entries.

pages.title: Regional Economies
pages.text: The Chaotic Star Sea, Great Jin, and Tianyuan City are the corpus's major auction and wholesale centers. Star Palace tax contracts, Anti-Star black-market credit, Tianyuan merit, and sect contribution are distinct currencies and will be documented separately.
